skylabs_brick.tests.unsupported_names

Require Import skylabs.lang.cpp.parser.
Require Import skylabs.lang.cpp.parser.plugin.cpp2v.
Require Import stdpp.fin_maps.

Names that may denote several entities

cpp2v prints some names with an unsupported atom: an unnamed struct at global scope is ?record, and a floating-point template argument is Aunsupported "<unknown>". Distinct entities can then share one name, and equal definitions would merge, so v<decltype(p)> and v<decltype(q)> below would be one global. cpp.prog therefore drops every symbol whose name contains an unsupported atom (has_unsupportedN), and makes every such type Gunsupported.

cpp.prog tu flags "-std=c++20" prog cpp:{{
  struct { int a; } *p;
  struct { int a; } *q;
  template <class T> char v = 0;
  template <double D> char w = 0;
  char *r = &v<decltype(p)>;
  char *s = &v<decltype(q)>;
  char *t = &w<1.0>;
  char *u = &w<2.0>;
}}.

Example no_unsupported_symbol :
  List.existsb (fun kv => has_unsupportedN kv.1) (map_to_list tu.(symbols)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

The types named ?record are there, but unsupported.
Example unsupported_type_present :
  List.existsb (fun kv => has_unsupportedN kv.1) (map_to_list tu.(types)) = true.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Example unsupported_types_quarantined :
  List.forallb (fun kv => negb (has_unsupportedN kv.1) || if kv.2 is Gunsupported _ then true else false)
    (map_to_list tu.(types)) = true.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Symbols with ordinary names are kept.
Example ordinary_symbols_kept :
  is_Some (tu.(symbols) !! "r"%cpp_name) /\ is_Some (tu.(symbols) !! "t"%cpp_name).
Proof. split; vm_compute; eexists; reflexivity. Qed.

decls records each dropped symbol once, in dropped_symbols: among them v<?record*> (for both r and s) and w<?> (for both t and u). Depending on the clang version, the implicit members of the unnamed structs (?record::<ctor>() and so on) are dropped too.
Example dropped_symbols_recorded :
  let ds := tu.(dropped_symbols) in
  List.forallb has_unsupportedN ds &&
  bool_decide (NoDup ds) &&
  bool_decide (Ninst (Nglobal (Nid "v")) [Atype (Tptr (Tnamed (Nglobal (Nunsupported_atomic "record"))))] ∈ ds) &&
  bool_decide (Ninst (Nglobal (Nid "w")) [Aunsupported "<unknown>"] ∈ ds) = true.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.
